blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City is rolling out a barangay-based program offering pet registration, spaying and neutering services, and anti-rabies services in selected communities throughout October. The Barangay Spaying and Neutering, Pet Registration and Anti-Rabies Program is scheduled to visit nine Cebu City barangays on selected dates from Oct. 1 to 29. Only Cebu […]...
